description: Tarpaulin coverage run (2026-06-13) identified gaps across 5 crates. Overall: jmap-types 97.9%, jmap-chat-types 84.0%, jmap-server 80.3%, jmap-chat-client 76.7%, jmap-chat-server 67.7%. This epic tracks per-file coverage improvement beads.
title: Test coverage gaps in chat + foundation crates
